programme.title: You Have Been Warned
programme.sub-title: A look at some of the most mind-blowing footage experts have seen, including see-through animals, algae-powered motorcycles and human-sized chickens
programme.desc: Forget everything you thought you knew about science - `Outrageous Acts of Science' proves that testing the principles of physics, chemistry, biology, and engineering isn't confined to just laboratories anymore. The fast-paced series scours the Web for the best self-appointed scientists whose homegrown research - mind-boggling experiments, extraordinary inventions and jaw-dropping scientific stunts - has gone viral. Hour-long episodes count down the best clips, supported by a team of actual scientists who analyse the principles behind the backyard shenanigans.

credits.actor: Alistair Linsell,Timothy Dabado,Helen Arney,Debbie Berebichez,Hakeem Oluseyi,Adam Ruben

programme.title: Food Factory
programme.sub-title: Reveals the mouthwatering secrets behind tasty treats. It's a wild culinary ride as mountains of raw materials are transformed. Featuring peanut buttercups and pasta sauce
programme.desc: Food Network Canada presents this eye-opening series featuring food factories. Each episode offers a behind-the-scenes view of production lines across the country to find out how some of the most-popular food items are really made. Through the ingredients, techniques and required processes, `Food Factory' reveals how raw ingredients are turned into everyday eats. In what some call a fascinating world, the manufacturing and technology that is being used in factories simplifies how the country gets its food.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures

programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Zak Bagans leads his team of co-investigators Nick Groff and Aaron Goodwin at haunted locations both in America and abroad, interviewing locals about alleged hauntings before going face to face with supernatural entities. credits.actor: Zak Bagans,Aaron Goodwin,Billy Tolley,Jay Wasley,Nick Groff

programme.desc: Telling powerful stories in hourlong episodes, TLC follows medical journeys of morbidly obese people as they attempt to save their own lives. The featured individuals - each weighing more than 600 pounds (42 stones - confront lifelong emotional and physical struggles as they make the courageous decision to undergo high-risk gastric bypass surgery. In addition to drastically changing their appearances, they hope to reclaim their independence, mend relationships with friends and family, and renew their feelings of self-worth.

programme.desc: The gold rush in Alaska isn't confined to the state's precious ground. It's taking place on the sea ... or more accurately, on the bottom of the frigid Bering Sea. The custom-built rigs, some barely seaworthy, include an 80-foot barge run by the most successful gold dredger in Nome, Alaska, and a modified skiff that seats only two people.

programme.title: Live: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to "SportsCenter" viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly "1 Big Thing" commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in "Bad Beats." The show also delivers what "SportsCenter" fans are used to -- news and highlights, guests and interviews -- but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way.

programme.desc: The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on "SportsCenter," ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. programme.title: Agni Vayu

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: AGNI VAYU
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore’S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore’.Tagore’S Words And Basu’S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children’s turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn’t happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani’s lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India’S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi’S & Bahu’S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What’S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law’s. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law’s family.

programme.title: Python Hunters
programme.desc: With invasive species invading Florida, it is up to animal control officers to deal with and get rid of the invading animals. Green iguanas, Nile monitors, rock pythons and Burmese pythons are among the most common species entering the Sunshine State. An elite squad of hunters, known as the Python Hunters, is fighting back. The Python Hunters are tasked with protecting the local environment by getting the invasive species under control. It's an important conservation mission and, if it fails, one of America's most-important ecosystems may never be able to recover.

programme.desc: After a botched mission, a SWAT team is sent to retrain in an abandoned hangar, where two rival mob factions wage war on them upon realising they lack ammunition.

programme.desc: Tiger Chen, a young martial artist, has unparalleled Tai Chi skills which lands him in a highly lucrative underworld fight club.

programme.desc: A gangster, who seeks to retire from the life of crime, faces a threat when an upcoming rival challenges his authority. He then decides to take help from a trustworthy former apprentice.

programme.title: Krampus
programme.desc: A boy who has a bad Christmas accidentally summons a festive demon to his family home.

programme.desc: Peter Parker faces Electro and his old friend who is dying and looks out for Spider-Man's blood in order to cure himself.

programme.title: Nightcrawler
programme.desc: Louis Bloom, a petty thief, realises that he can make money by capturing photographs of crime scenes and starts resorting to extreme tactics to get them.

programme.title: The Trust
programme.desc: Two financially stressed police officers discover that a petty drug dealer has hidden large amounts of money in a safe, and they plot to steal it. However, things do not go as planned.

programme.title: Desert Lions
programme.desc: Witness a mega lion pride battling to survive during the deadly dry season that tests their resilience in Nxai Pan, Botswana.

programme.title: Return of the Lion
programme.desc: A group of lions from South Africa make the arduous journey to Akagera National Park in Rwanda to form a new pride. However, they must band together to thrive in this unfamiliar environment.

programme.title: South Africa
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores South Africa's diverse Cape region, where the lush and magnificent habitats of Africa and Antarctica collide.

programme.title: Eye of the Leopard
programme.desc: The filmmaker captures the remarkable beauty of one leopardess's life in the Mombo region of the Okavango Delta from her wobbly days as a cub to an adult as an independent predator.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Chemical weaponry and stealth are the names of the game for Africa's snakes, who prefer to remain hidden until the very last moment.

programme.title: Russia's Wild Tiger
programme.desc: The filmmaker explores the lives of Siberian tigers, an endangered species struggling for survival, and the challenges of human-wildlife conflict.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: After a treacherous drought, the rains bring relief to all the inhabitants of the parched land. But will this change makes things difficult in the coming days?

programme.title: Cheetah: The Maasai Brotherhood
programme.desc: The filmmaker sheds light on the Tana Bora, an alliance of five cheetahs who have grown into a formidable hunting unit that takes down large prey and survives super predators of the savannah.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: The animals indulge in dangerous fights with one another in order to survive and protect themselves in the unpredictable circumstances of the wild.

programme.title: Lion Battle Zone
programme.desc: Five prides of lions compete in harsh environments, triggering their survival instincts to overcome challenges of food scarcity.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: The filmmaker gives a profound insight into lethal animals armed with savage canines that can tear their prey apart in seconds.

programme.title: Jade Eyed Leopard
programme.desc: The filmmaker traces the journey of a jade eyed leopard, highlighting the skills learned by the predator to survive in the wild.

programme.title: Big Cat Games
programme.desc: The filmmaker gives a comprehensive insight into the predatory nature of wild cats, by pitting them against each other and testing their skills.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Crocodiles, hippos and big predatory cats engage in a lethal and vicious battle with each other in order to determine the ruler of Africa's waterways.

programme.title: The Real Black Panther

Chumbo: Made for Big Wave Surfing
programme.desc: Getting a glimpse into surfer Lucas Chianca's incredible life as the Brazilian waterman balances chasing heavy waves around the world with his biggest challenge yet, becoming a father for the first time.

programme.title: WRC: More Than Machine
programme.sub-title: We join the team for round four in Croatia. Adrien Fourmaux returns to the rally he crashed out on in WRC2, while Gregoire Munster puts his trust in the team's weather forecaster
programme.desc: Series following members of the M-Sport WRC team about the trials and tribulations of competing in Rally driving at the highest level.

programme.title: Beyond the ROX
programme.sub-title: HYROX athletes grind in the off-season to balance their personal lives with the ambition, endurance, recovery, and mental and physical strength required to compete with the Elite 15
programme.desc: The best HYROX athletes uncover what it takes to rise to the top.

programme.title: Natural Heights
programme.sub-title: Alberto López and his partner Jenya race up 180m of hard multi-pitch climbing on Switzerland's Verzasca Dam
programme.desc: Follow two parallel stories: climbers battling gravity to conquer new heights, while navigating their journeys off the wall.

programme.title: Red Bull Cliff Diving World Series
programme.sub-title: With everything at stake, Constantin Popovici and Kaylea Arnett need to dig deep to perfect their dives
programme.desc: Athletes compete to execute acrobatic dives from great heights in the Red Bull Cliff Diving World Series, a major diving tournament.

programme.title: Nazaré: Making Giants
programme.desc: Lucas Chumbo and Kai Lenny push the boundaries of what's plausible on a big wave.

credits.actor: Pedro Scooby,Kai Lenny,Lucas Chumbo,Rodrigo Koxa,Justine Dupont

programme.title: Red Bull Stalen Ros
programme.sub-title: This wild water race tests speed, teamwork and balance as riders try to stay dry on a fun and tricky course
programme.desc: Teams try to navigate a track over water which includes obstacles on their customised bicycles.

programme.title: Red Bull Soapbox Race
programme.sub-title: More thrills, spills, customer carts and crashes in this extreme downhill battle at the Eduardo VII Park in Lisbon
programme.desc: All the thrills and spills from the Red Bull Soapbox Race as teams of racers test themselves by hurtling down challenging, obstacle-filled courses in homemade, motorless soapbox race cars.

programme.title: Red Bull Soapbox Race
programme.sub-title: The Red Bull Soap Box race heads to Johannesburg, South Africa
programme.desc: All the thrills and spills from the Red Bull Soapbox Race as teams of racers test themselves by hurtling down challenging, obstacle-filled courses in homemade, motorless soapbox race cars.

programme.title: Red Bull Films
programme.sub-title: Follow Asa Vermette, one of mountain biking's most exciting young riders, on his debut at Red Bull Hardline
programme.desc: All the magazines and documentaries from the Red Bull universe. Whether it's winter or summer sports, you won't miss a thing.

programme.title: Reel Rock
programme.sub-title: Will Moss puts The Gunks on the map after climbing a legendary cliff in the northeastern US
programme.desc: Follows the world's top climbers, alpinists and mountaineers to the wildest places on Earth. New stories of triumph, failure and redemption unfold as they pursue the thrill of adventure.

programme.title: Masters of Dirt - Total Freestyle Tour
programme.desc: Dive into the thrilling world. Insane tricks, world records and wild stories await in an unforgettable journey to the heart of extreme sports, motocross, MTB, BMX and much more.

programme.title: Natural Heights
programme.sub-title: Janja Garnbret is chasing her tenth world title, and the pressure is unlike anything she has faced before. Will shifting to the outdoors for new motivation help her, or push her closer to cracking?
programme.desc: Follow two parallel stories: climbers battling gravity to conquer new heights, while navigating their journeys off the wall.

programme.title: Together We Rise: The Uncompromised Story of GRM Daily
programme.desc: A look at GRM Daily and its historical highs and lows.

programme.title: Beyond the ROX
programme.sub-title: The pressure has peaked for Jake Dearden as he qualifies for the final, new competitors challenge the veterans, and the growth of the women's field proves expert coaching can change the game
programme.desc: The best HYROX athletes uncover what it takes to rise to the top.

programme.title: Red Bull Rampage

programme.sub-title: Siebe Vanhee recruits his childhood heroes, Sean Villanueva O'Driscoll and Nico Favresse, to attempt the first free ascent of an alpine big wall in Patagonia, Argentina

programme.title: Saajan
programme.desc: Brothers Aman and Akash both fall for Pooja. While each is ready to sacrifice his love for the other, the choice ultimately lies with Pooja, who must decide between them.

programme.desc: A powerful businesswoman's body vanishes from the morgue; an inspector pursues truth. Questioning her husband reveals deeper secrets, suggesting the case is more tangled than expected.

programme.desc: Rahul sets out to immerse his grandfather's ashes at Rameshwaram, but after helping runaway bride Meena board a train, he ends up clashing with her dangerous criminal family.

programme.desc: Devdas is forbidden by his rich family from marrying the woman he loves. Heartbroken, he turns to alcohol and a life of ruin, unable to escape the pain of lost love.

Ghosts
programme.sub-title: When a TV documentary crew comes to Woodstone Mansion to shoot an episode of 'Dumb Deaths', Pete confronts a hard truth about the day he dies
programme.desc: Samantha, a cheerful freelance journalist, and Jay, an up-and-coming chef from the city, throw both caution and money to the wind when they decide to convert a huge run-down country estate they inherited into a bed and breakfast -- only to find it's inhabited by the many spirits of deceased residents. The departed souls are a close-knit, eclectic group that includes a saucy Prohibition-era lounge singer, a pompous 1700's Militiaman, a '60s hippie fond of hallucinogens and an overly upbeat '80s scout troop leader. If the spirits were anxious about the commotion a renovation and B\u0026B will create in their home, it's nothing compared to when they realize Samantha is the first live person who can see and hear them.

programme.title: The Revenant
programme.desc: While exploring the uncharted wilderness in 1823, frontiersman Hugh Glass (Leonardo DiCaprio) sustains life-threatening injuries from a brutal bear attack. When a member (Tom Hardy) of his hunting team kills his young son (Forrest Goodluck) and leaves him for dead, Glass must utilize his survival skills to find a way back to civilization. Grief-stricken and fueled by vengeance, the legendary fur trapper treks through the snowy terrain to track down the man who betrayed him.

programme.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)
programme.desc: Former cinema superhero Riggan Thomson (Michael Keaton) is mounting an ambitious Broadway production that he hopes will breathe new life into his stagnant career. It's risky, but he hopes that his creative gamble will prove that he's a real artist and not just a washed-up movie star. As opening night approaches, a castmate is injured, forcing Riggan to hire an actor (Edward Norton) who is guaranteed to shake things up. Meanwhile, Riggan must deal with his girlfriend, daughter and ex-wife.

programme.desc: S1 E427 Saxena spikes Vibhuti's drink to seek revenge for a lie and blackmails him with a video. Later, Vibhuti is forced to tease Angoori to prevent his wife from seeing the incriminating footage.
programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.desc: S1 E428 Saxena coerces Vibhuti into teasing Angoori and ruining Anita's hair with gum. To hide his actions, Vibhuti blames a priest's orders, but the truth begins to unravel when Anita informs Manmohan.
programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.desc: S1 E429 Saxena forces Vibhuti to smear mud on Manmohan's face and slap Happu. Later, Vibhuti apologises to everyone after the torment ends, but he unexpectedly repeats his antics on Manmohan.
programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.desc: S1 E430 Anita intends to end her marriage until Saxena explains the truth behind Vibhuti's actions. Meanwhile, Angoori houses three homeless men, causing an argument with Manmohan.
programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.desc: S1 E431 Vibhuti spikes food in revenge and later gets thrashed while sneaking into Angoori's room. Meanwhile, Manmohan joins Saxena's protest against builders, leading to chaotic clashes.
programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.desc: S1 E432 Vibhuti and Manmohan evict the trio after they reclaim their homes. Later, Manmohan discovers a sleepwalking Anita on his sofa while Vibhuti pretends to be an astronaut to impress Angoori.
programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.desc: S1 E433 Vibhuti wears a spacesuit to converse with his neighbor Angoori. Meanwhile, Manmohan consults a doctor regarding Anita's sleepwalking.
programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.desc: S1 E434 After Vibhuti pretends to be an astronaut to impress Angoori, Happu mistakes him for a criminal in a spacesuit. To keep up the ruse, Vibhuti has Saxena pose as a Martian to delight Angoori.
programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.desc: S1 E435 After Tiwari ruins the ending of a mystery novel for Anita, she agrees to host the author, Abhay. Later, Abhay begins writing a new story that strangely mirrors the lives of the local residents.
programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.desc: S1 E436 As Abhay narrates his novel, the events eerily come to life when Martha attacks Vibhuti. While Anita realizes Martha is a character from the book, Saxena causes more chaos dressed as Hilda.
programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.desc: S1 E437 Abhay forces the neighbours to hear his story, while Martha beats Manmohan and Happu for eyeing other women. Fearing a deadly climax, the men beg Abhay to change the ending before Martha appears.
programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.desc: S1 E438 Happu exposes Abhay's promotional stunt involving a fake Martha. Meanwhile, Angoori's grandmother wakes from a coma and tests Manmohan with questions that Vibhuti answers.
programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.desc: S1 E439 Vibhuti introduces Anita as his cousin, and Ammaji reprimands Tiwari regarding Angoori. Later, Vibhuti decides to offer his place in the upcoming wedding rituals to comfort a saddened Tiwari.
programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.desc: S1 E440 At Angoori's pre-wedding celebration, Anita and others perform dances. Subsequently, Granny instructs Vibhuti and Angoori to share confectionery in a customary ritual.
programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.desc: S1 E441 Govinda visits Anita's house under the impression that it is for sale and dances with everyone. Later, Vibhuti refuses to return home, prompting Anita to ask Manmohan to do the housework.
programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.desc: S1 E442 Anita scolds Vibhuti for poor laundry work, while Tiwari stops Angoori from working. Later, a gangster's strange threats force the men to dress as women.
programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.desc: S1 E59 Discharged with advanced cancer, Meera receives a wig from her sister, Diya. The wig possesses her with a spirit intent on stopping Diya's marriage, forcing Kabir to try and save his fiancée's life.
programme.title: Laal Ishq

programme.desc: S1 E109 The malicious witch Jeeva spreads terror among the residents of Sigur by snatching the babies from pregnant women. Suyash and his expectant wife return to the village to sell land.
programme.title: Laal Ishq

programme.desc: S1 E103 Kanha fearlessly discloses his true identity to Kansa, yet the ruler remains trapped in an enduring dilemma. Consequently, he stubbornly refuses to believe this revelation.
programme.title: Paramavatar Shri Krishna

programme.desc: S1 E5 Raghu warns everyone to stay inside after dark, but Ganesh goes out anyway. He blames Sushma for the house's strange events, while Neelima insists on going back to Mumbai.
programme.title: Raat Ka Khel Saara

programme.desc: S1 E1046 Saxena plays a prank on Tiwari and Vibhuti after they boast about their bravery to everyone. Meanwhile, the boys find a bag of money but panic when a stranger claims there is a bomb inside.
programme.title: Bhabi ji Ghar Par Hai!

programme.desc: S1 E105 Saavi attacks her uncle under Sheena's possession, and everyone believes her mental state has become worse. Soon, Geeta forces Jeetu to send Saavi to a mental asylum, leaving her shocked.

programme.desc: S1 E40 Happu angers the commissioner by wearing informal attire to the office. Meanwhile, Raju and Sarika resolve their previous arguments, ending the conflict between them.
